name: How long does a multi-height countertop installation typically take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a multi-height countertop installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The installation timeline for a multi-height countertop varies based on factors like material choice, kitchen size, design complexity, and any necessary demolition. Typically, after materials are ordered and fabricated, the physical installation can take anywhere from one to three days. This estimate does not include the initial design consultation, measurement, or material fabrication time, which can add several weeks to the overall project duration. We provide a detailed project schedule after initial design finalization.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation typically takes 1-3 days, not including design, measurement, or fabrication time.
